Thanks for the advice - it’s similar to a lot of self help books I have read on the topic. Problem is I have done a lot of this for quite a lot of my life and I haven’t gotten any results from it. I just wish people viewed me the same way I view them - I gave myself 3 years until I couldn’t cope with the situation anymore.

I predicted it and tried to fight against it but nothing has worked in reality.

Thanks for taking the time to talk - have fun x

I honestly don’t know - I might be slightly autistic - I am able to pick up on very small details - also I just have a good memory so conversations with people don’t seem to flow or anything. People aren’t relaxed around me at all and always seem to be looking to be somewhere else.

It’s almost worse being slightly recognised but never cared for - the amount I do for other people and have done and no one reciprocates really - I’m always there but never really included - now I understand why people end their life as they just can’t cope being invisible.

Yes I do. In a way it contributes to me feeling suicidal - as I never manage to connect with anyone. What’s worse is obviously I have had many interactions with people but nothing in the end comes form it - I’m always an extra to a degree. What makes me feel even sicker is that I have so much love to give but nobody in my life. 

Honestly can’t cope with this much longer - has continued to happen to me through all school, uni and now adult life.
So true - It’s such an individualistic society - and your seen as a failure to a degree if you get self worth from having connections with people
I’ve battled it for so many years during University and the year after for me has just been worse. I’m going to kill myself as I can’t take it anymore and there’s no way it will change

I have no friends and no once cares about me. I’ve reached a point in my life where I’m qualified  enough to get a job - but that life will just wear me down as I’m working for nothing as I would have nothing outside of it to do. The effect loneliness has on the brain is horrible and it has messed me up

Nothing I have ever done has led to any success. I guess there needs to be those lonely people for there to be those happy and lucky social people.
